title: Simple Variable Mass 6DOF (Quaternion)
text: 实现相对于体轴的简单变质量六自由度运动方程的四元数表示，输入 4 路、输出 10 路；按 {Mass type} 指定质量类型 Simple；{Units}、{Initial position in inertial axes [Xe,Ye,Ze]}、{Initial velocity in body axes [U,v,w]}、{Initial Euler orientation [roll, pitch, yaw]}、{Initial body rotation rates [p,q,r]}、{Initial mass}、{Empty mass}、{Full mass}、{Inertia}、{Empty inertia}、{Full inertia}、{Include mass flow relative velocity}、{Output mass properties for acceleration computation}、{Velocity: e.g., ’U’,’v’,’w’}、{Position: e.g., ’Xe’,’Ye’,’Ze’}、{Body rotation rates: e.g., ’p’,’q’,’r’}、{Quaternion: e.g., ’qr’,’qi’,’qj’,’qk’}、{Mass: e.g., ’mass’} 同样影响行为。

params.name: Units
params.values: 输入和输出单位 Metric (MKS) (default) | English (Velocity in ft/s) | English (Velocity in kts)

params.name: Mass type
params.values: 质量类型 Simple Variable (default) | Fixed | Custom Variable

params.name: Initial position in inertial axes [Xe,Ye,Ze]
params.values: 惯性坐标轴中的位置 [0 0 0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: Initial velocity in body axes [U,v,w]
params.values: 体轴中的速度 [0 0 0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: Initial Euler orientation [roll, pitch, yaw]
params.values: 初始欧拉姿态 [0 0 0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: Initial body rotation rates [p,q,r]
params.values: 初始机体旋转 [0 0 0] (default) | three-element vector

params.name: Empty inertia
params.values: 空载惯性矩阵 eye(3) (default) | 3-by-3 matrix

params.name: Include mass flow relative velocity
params.values: 质量流相对速度端口 off (default) | on

params.name: Output mass properties for acceleration computation
params.values: 包含用于加速度端口的质量属性 off (default) | on

params.name: Velocity: e.g., {’U’,’v’,’w’}
params.values: 速度状态名称 ’’ (default) | comma-separated list surrounded by braces

params.name: Position: e.g., {’Xe’,’Ye’,’Ze’}
params.values: 位置状态名称 ’’ (default) | comma-separated list surrounded by braces

params.name: Body rotation rates: e.g., {’p’,’q’,’r’}
params.values: 机体旋转状态名称 ’’ (default) | comma-separated list surrounded by braces

params.name: Quaternion: e.g., {’qr’,’qi’,’qj’,’qk’}
params.values: 四元数向量状态名称 ’’ (default) | comma-separated list surrounded by braces

params.name: Mass: e.g., ’mass’
params.values: 质量状态名称 ’’ (default) | character vector
